artwork.title: One platform. Independent apps
artwork.style: Japanese paper theatre viewed from backstage, handmade cut edges and colour gels
artwork.caption: App Composer. Japanese paper theatre viewed from backstage, handmade cut edges and colour gels.

artwork.title: App Composer
artwork.style: Pulp paperback cover drawn with one large focal gesture and two tiny witnesses
artwork.caption: An agent-operated studio for building and maintaining web apps with EmDash and Cloudflare. Prepare the environment, describe the brief, build the app, keep the source. Your repo, your account. Get ready → Init → Build → Operate.

artwork.title: LDraw
artwork.style: Black hardboard scratch engraving with one fluorescent intervention and rough copper edges
artwork.caption: A local-first Excalidraw workspace with real portfolio artwork, editable architecture scenes and a distraction-free presentation view. Drawings stay in the browser. The real editor. Draw → Insert → Present → Export.

artwork.title: Paperwork
artwork.style: Oversized municipal office rubber stamp leaves an ink crater in a crowded municipal desk
artwork.caption: Add text, ticks, ink, highlights and a signature to an ordinary PDF, then save a completed copy. Nothing is uploaded and no account is needed. No document upload. Open → Fill → Sign → Save.

artwork.title: Here / there
artwork.style: Nighttime blue-hour diorama made entirely of waxed postcards and tiny wire supports
artwork.caption: A moderated photo guestbook. Visitors send a postcard, the owner reviews it, and only approved moments become part of the public wall. Review before publish. Post → Review → Approve → Display.

artwork.title: Linkarooie
artwork.style: Lime and violet felt puppet set with close forced perspective and obvious thumbprints
artwork.caption: One public profile with ordered links and approved photos. Linkarooie owns its records and reads Guestbook content through a versioned service binding. Your page, your order. Curate → Bind → Publish → Share.

artwork.title: Link Check
artwork.style: Exploded mechanical watch in a single tint, staged as a railway crossing that just caught a train
artwork.caption: Paste one public HTTPS page and inspect its title, icons, share images, metadata and crawl signals in a dated report you can hand to an agent. Not a crawler. Paste → Check → Fetch → Report.

artwork.title: Carry / forward
artwork.style: Cut-metal travel poster assembled from repurposed ticket machines, harsh white sidelight
artwork.caption: A fictional memory vault you choose, encrypt locally and carry as a file. No cloud vault, no account and no silent sync. Local encryption. Create → Select → Encrypt → Carry.

artwork.title: Hello World
artwork.style: Prismatic lenticular artwork with two visible physical perspectives separated by folded ridges
artwork.caption: One configurable page, one origin, no hidden backend. The smallest honest release — and the proof that setup reached HTTPS. Nothing hidden. Configure → Deploy → Verify → Share.

artwork.title: Launch Kit
artwork.style: Fluorescent mineral cabinet under museum lighting, one specimen halfway out of its slot
artwork.caption: Turn one piece of local artwork into checked icons, install assets and three exact share images — then inspect every decoded file before it leaves the browser. Source stays local. Choose → Crop → Compose → Inspect.

artwork.title: Asset Hunter
artwork.style: One continuous silver gesture carved into black ceramic, with the action seen in relief
artwork.caption: A searchable field guide to creative and technical possibilities, with provenance, rights and build notes attached to every example. Rights on the record. Search → Drill in → Check → Package.

artwork.title: MAX
artwork.style: Antique card box assembled as a miniature corner shop with doors and shelves of tiny props
artwork.caption: Explore the software simulator and its locator cue. Hardware remains a target design.

artwork.title: Protocol 11
artwork.style: Underwater rubber tide-chart print with squeegee drag and pockets of black ink
artwork.caption: A card game for two to four players where the table changes every round. Play solo through the House Circuit or pass the device around. No downloads, one table. Deal → Read → Play → Next.

artwork.title: Bubbles
artwork.style: Folded wrestling programme at the bottom of a school bag, only the scene comes to life
artwork.caption: A premium browser bubble shooter with authored worlds, saved progress and stars. Runs in a tab; nothing to install. Feels right on a phone. Aim → Match → Clear → Return.

artwork.title: SHOALSHOT
artwork.style: Graphite excavation rubbing, stratified ink and paper, original evidence objects only
artwork.caption: A tactile fishing game built phone-first: read the water, place one shot, land the catch, then share the dive as a local card. One cast, five minutes. Read → Place → Land → Share.

artwork.title: LOFTWAH FIGHTER
artwork.style: Records cut in coloured acetate and stacked into a repeating physical motif
artwork.caption: Collect authored fighters, build a squad and commit moves on a shared real-time Charge Strip. Quick battles, a story and a collection to build. Readable battles. Collect → Build → Charge → Win.

artwork.title: Pirates
artwork.style: Watercolour in the style of an illustrated train-window scene, with one hard-edged object near the glass
artwork.caption: An archive study about reconstructing a game from documented source evidence.

artwork.title: LoftwahFM
artwork.style: Mid-century search-and-rescue equipment insert, wax pencil and luminous blue paper
artwork.caption: A catalogue, continuous stations and original shows in the browser — with a player that games can reuse instead of rebuilding. Listen without an account. Browse → Queue → Play → Reuse.

artwork.title: Plans With You
artwork.style: Matchboxes form a cabinet with individually painted art visible inside the drawers
artwork.caption: An archive illustration about the pressure to fill an evening.

artwork.title: Liferaft
artwork.style: Two-tone woodblock carved across a wooden tool bench, the woodgrain is part of the drawing
artwork.caption: A local desktop app for searching MBOX email archives, previewing messages and recovering just the attachment or message you need. Read-only by default. Add → Index → Search → Recover.

artwork.title: Foilbury
artwork.style: A dismantled wind-up stage with coloured housings visibly separated by mechanical interlocks
artwork.caption: A free album for original character cards. Browse the public cabinet, open a capsule, and keep the copy, finish and serial that came out. The cards are the point. Browse → Open → Keep → Build.

artwork.title: Woodhouse
artwork.style: Wire armature and thread pulling a flat paper scene into three-dimensional space
artwork.caption: The public observatory for the factory: dated project dossiers, dispatches, architecture, incidents and a bounded agent-readable view. Dated, not implied. Author → Review → Publish → Record.
